features: Supported cameras: HD-TVI : 5MP, 4MP, 1080P, 720P / AHD : 5MP, 4MP, 1080P, 720P / CVBS : NTSC / PAL / IP (DirectIP, IDIS) : Up to 12MP(Depending on IP Camera)
Recording compression: Analog : H.265, Intelligent Codec / IP : H.265, H.264, Intelligent Codec
Trigger events: Motion, Tampering, Video Loss, Alarm In, Network Alarm, Text-in, System, Etc.
Expandable up to 12TB using 2 SATA interfaces
notes: Network ports: one client Ethernet port plus one RJ45 port for IP cameras; the camera port speed is not stated.
Video inputs stated as 8 channels (8 BNC, 1 RJ45: up to 4 IP cameras switchable), so IP channels come out of the 8-channel total.
